robot.name: NEURA 4NE1
robot.status_notes: Preorders/reservations open for 4NE1 Gen 3.5 at EUR 98,000; expected availability end of 2026. No confirmed deliveries or shipping found in reviewed sources. Official page says Gen 4 is already running in NEURA Gyms and being prepared for series production.

height.notes: Official product page lists Height (cm) 180. RobotHub.app also lists 180 cm.

weight.notes: Weight 80 kg is from RobotHub.app directory. The official product page has a Weight (kg) row but the value is not visible in the captured text, so official weight is not confirmed.

payload.notes: Official product page lists Payload (kg) 10-20. RobotHub.app lists dual-arm payload 20 kg. Maximum payload used as numeric value.

runtime.notes: Reported by Robofy, added 2026-10-29 by automated spec fill; Listed as a 6–8 hour range for 4NE1 Gen 3.5 with hot-swappable batteries; lower bound used..

battery.notes: Reservation FAQ says each 4NE1 will include a high-capacity battery and dedicated charging station, but no capacity or runtime is stated.

degrees_of_freedom.notes: Reported by robothub.app, added 2026-10-29 by automated spec fill; Aggregator lists 42+ DOF; its own narrative also says the DOF row is unpublished, so treat as caveated aggregator data..

walking_speed.notes: RobotHub.app lists Max Speed 5 km/h in its spec table, but the same article says the speed row is empty. The official product page has a speed (km/h) row without a visible value. Low confidence.

hands.description: Integrated high-dexterity hands; exchangeable forearms; advanced hands with more accurate grip; high-torque actuation; limb reflexes for precise motion. No hand DoF published.
hands.force_feedback: Contact and force sensing claimed via sensor skin and NEURON AI (company claim).

compute.description: Gen 4 runs on NEURA's multimodal Physical AI foundation model NEURON AI; all processing claimed to run locally on the robot. No processor, TOPS or memory size is published.

actuators.description: High-torque actuation claimed by NEURA Robotics. Reflexes built into the limbs allow each limb to react on its own. No actuator types, torque numbers or count published.

availability.notes: Gen 3.5 preorder: EUR 98,000 per unit for 1-19 units, EUR 60,000 per unit for 20+ units, excluding taxes and shipping. Reservation fee EUR 100 per unit, fully refundable. Expected available end of 2026. No Gen 4 price found.

manipulation_dexterity.summary: Official page claims advanced hands with more accurate grip, integrated high-dexterity hands, and exchangeable forearms. A 2024 YouTube video title indicates a sandwich crafted by a humanoid, but no transcript is available to verify the manipulation. No success rates or independent dexterity benchmarks found.
caveats: Video title only; no transcript or visual verification by the researcher.
Company claims are not independently measured.
Sandwich demo is from 2024 and may be an earlier 4NE-1 prototype.

autonomy_task_execution.summary: NEURA claims Gen 4 runs the NEURON AI foundation model locally and that 4NE1 navigates unstructured industrial environments, understands complex tasks, and responds in real time. Reservation page lists teleoperation as an available interface, indicating teleoperation is a supported mode. No fully autonomous claim or intervention-free operation is demonstrated in reviewed sources.
caveats: Autonomy is company-asserted and not independently verified.
Teleoperation interface is sold as a feature, so autonomy is not full.
No intervention counts or failure rates published.

mobility_whole_body_control.summary: RobotHub.app lists biped locomotion and max speed 5 km/h; official page says Gen 4 is smoother in every movement and has reflexes in the limbs. A YouTube title says a headless 4NE1 walks through Zurich, but no transcript is available. No dynamic mobility metrics, fall recovery, or whole-body control demonstrations with details were found.
caveats: Directory speed value conflicts with its own note that the speed row is empty.
Walking demo is title only; no gait quality or autonomy mode disclosed.
No whole-body control metrics or disturbance tests.

perception_scene_understanding.summary: Official page claims 360-degree perception, sensor skin, 3D vision, contact and force sensing, hearing what it cannot see, and computer vision. RobotHub.app notes no camera model, lidar model or tactile sensor count is published, so hardware details are unknown.
caveats: Perception claims are company claims with no independent benchmark.
No sensor hardware specs or counts released.

human_interaction.summary: Official page positions 4NE1 for safe human interaction, natural voice commands, and home assistance; reservation page lists multi-modal interaction use cases. No user study, interaction reliability metric, or conversational test found.
caveats: Voice-command interaction is claimed but not demonstrated in available transcripts.
No social or conversational evaluation.

endurance_reliability.summary: No runtime, battery capacity, MTBF, or reliability data were published in reviewed sources. Reservation FAQ states a high-capacity battery and charging station are included, but no hours or failure rates are given.
caveats: No endurance or reliability evidence found.
RobotHub.app confirms battery runtime row is empty in official specs.

human_environment_fit.summary: Humanoid height 180 cm, weight 80 kg, textile skin for approachability, and claims of safe human interaction. No safety certification, force-limited joint data, or independent safety testing was found.
caveats: Weight 80 kg is from RobotHub.app, not confirmed in official visible text.
No safety certification or third-party safety assessment published.

deployment_commercial_proof.summary: No named customer deployments, shipped units, or operational metrics were found. Preorder is open for Gen 3.5 but not yet shipping. Official page says Gen 4 is already running in NEURA Gyms and being prepared for series production.
caveats: No customer names or deployment numbers.
Reservation/preorder is not commercial proof.
No pilot or trial metrics published.

accessibility_value.summary: Gen 3.5 is listed at EUR 98,000 per unit (1-19 units) or EUR 60,000 (20+ units) with a refundable EUR 100 reservation fee; expected availability end of 2026. No Gen 4 price found.
caveats: Gen 4 price not published.
Not yet shipping; preorder terms apply and may change.
Price excludes taxes and shipping.

researcher_notes.short_verdict_for_arena: NEURA 4NE1 is a German full-size humanoid with a preorder path for Gen 3.5 and a revealed Gen 4, but public evidence is thin: no runtime, no official DoF, no customer deployments, and video evidence is only YouTube titles without transcripts. Official page claims multimodal AI, advanced hands, and industrial/home use, but autonomy is unproven and the robot is not yet shipping.
strongest_positive_evidence: Official reservation page price and end-2026 availability for Gen 3.5.
Official Gen 4 hardware/software claims including NEURON AI, 360° perception, sensor skin, and advanced hands.
Video title indicating a sandwich-making demo and a walking demo through Zurich, but only title-level evidence.
weakest_or_missing_evidence: No runtime, battery capacity, or endurance data.
No official total DoF or walking speed; directory value conflicts with its own note.
No customer deployments, pilots, or shipped units.
No video transcripts; observed capabilities cannot be verified beyond titles.
conflicting_claims: RobotHub.app lists 42+ DOF and 5 km/h, but its own text says the official speed, DoF, and runtime rows are empty.
Weight 80 kg is from RobotHub.app; official product page has a Weight row but no visible value in captured text.
Price is for Gen 3.5 only; no Gen 4 price is provided.
do_not_overclaim: Do not credit 4NE1 Mini claims (source 7) to the full-scale 4NE1.
Do not treat preorder as shipping or commercial deployment.
Do not credit total DoF 42+ or max speed 5 km/h as official; directory conflict remains.
Do not describe video content beyond the provided titles.
Do not infer autonomy from official marketing language.

currentness.currentness_notes: 4NE1 Gen 4 is the latest generation revealed as of 2026-10-27. Gen 3.5 is available for preorder. No later generation found.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: NEURA 4NE1 is a German full-size cognitive humanoid with a Gen 4 version and a Gen 3.5 preorder. The official page lists 180 cm height, 10-20 kg payload, advanced hands, 360° perception, sensor skin, local NEURON AI foundation model, and industrial/home use cases. A reservation page prices Gen 3.5 at EUR 98,000 (1-19) / EUR 60,000 (20+) with end-2026 availability. Evidence is thin: no runtime, total DoF, customer deployments or named pilots, and video evidence consists of YouTube titles only with no transcripts. The robot is not yet shipping.
strongest_evidence: Official preorder pricing and end-2026 availability for 4NE1 Gen 3.5 (neura-4ne1_evidence_008; neura-4ne1_evidence_009).
Official Gen 4 product page claims: 20% lighter, NEURON AI local processing, advanced hands and 360-degree perception (neura-4ne1_evidence_001; neura-4ne1_evidence_002; neura-4ne1_evidence_004).
Official reservation page confirms integrated high-dexterity hands, high-capacity battery and dedicated charging station included (neura-4ne1_evidence_010).
weakest_evidence: No runtime, battery capacity, total DoF or official walking speed published; directory fields conflict with official empty rows (neura-4ne1_evidence_014).
No named customer deployments, shipped units or operational metrics found (no evidence item; see limitations_and_unknowns).
No video transcripts; all video evidence is title-only and not visually verified (neura-4ne1_evidence_012 indicates prototype demo history only; actual video titles are in demos array).
known_do_not_credit: Do not credit total DoF 42+ or 5 km/h speed as official; directory conflict remains.
Do not credit 4NE1 Mini claims as full-scale 4NE1.
Do not treat preorder as shipping or commercial deployment.
Do not describe video content beyond the provided titles.
Do not infer autonomy from official marketing language.
